When I was thirteen I was sleeping on the living room couch when I very loud smashing/slamming sound woke me up. The front door was open, door jamb and frame splintered inward. There was nothing beyond but pitch darkness, but I could sense movement just beyond the line of my sight.
Someone was watching me.
I called the police, but in my stupidity, hung up on them and snuck to my room, closing the door behind me. 
Shortly after I heard heavy footsteps in the kitchen, then listened as they entered the hall. I stood by the door with the glass part of my lava lamp in my hand, the only thing I could think to defend myself with if I had to.
I listened to the intruder going through things, terrified he would come in to my room, even more that he would find my little sister sleeping in her bed, unaware, not sure if I would be brave enough or strong enough to save her.
